extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers and NIH staff who need to locate critique templates in IAR
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for where and how reviewers (and NIH staff) can find and download critique templates in the NIH eRA IAR system for the applications they are reviewing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting Materials folder access
rubrics_metrics.description: Critique templates can be found in IAR’s meeting materials folder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access via the Meeting Materials screen; use the three-dot ellipses icons where 'View Template' and 'View' links appear (see Figure 1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Critique Template link on List of My Assigned Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: By clicking on the application’s 'Critique Template' link on the List of My Assigned Applications screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'Critique Template' link is accessed from the three-dot ellipses icon on the List of All Applications screen as well (see Figure 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Download Assigned Critique Templates ZIP via Download button
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers can download all critique templates for all applications specifically assigned to them by using the Download button on the List of My Assigned Applications screen or the List of All Applications screen and selecting the Assigned Critique Templates ZIP option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Download button and choose 'Assigned Critique Templates ZIP' to get all templates for your assigned applications (see Figure 3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigned Critique Templates ZIP availability condition
rubrics_metrics.description: The Assigned Critique Templates ZIP option only shows if all the applications in the meeting have associated templates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are any unassigned or assigned applications with no associated template, the link for the zip file will not appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-IAR access restriction for critique templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Only NIH Staff can access critique templates prior to providing access through IAR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers without NIH Staff privileges cannot access templates before they are provided through IAR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support/contact
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any questions, contact your SRO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs reviewers to contact their Scientific Review Officer (SRO) for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental resource link
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional resource: 'Reviewers: Locating Critique Template link in IAR' (Word - 232KB) (September 2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the linked Word document for step-by-step help or screenshots.
